thread:
Mira: Quick follow-up from last night's authz incident — I'm collecting owners, short timelines, and a recurring-check schedule. Main failure vectors: token validation gaps, permission drift on service roles, audit events not tagged, and a secrets-rotation job that silently errored.
Alex: Thanks. Can you dump the action items here? I'll take token validation checks. :+1:
Mira: Sure — keeping these lightweight so they land in the sprint. A1) Token TTL + validation healthcheck (owner: Alex, due: 2026-03-30, ticket INF-4882). Short description: add periodic end-to-end validation and alert on >1% validation error rate over 10m.
Alex: I'll add a grafana panel and alert. Proposed query for infra metrics: ```promql
sum(rate(token_validation_failures_total[10m])) / sum(rate(token_validation_attempts_total[10m])) > 0.01
```
Sam: I'll take A2) Permission drift detector (owner: Sam, due: 2026-04-06, ticket INF-4883). Plan: weekly scan comparing RBAC manifests vs allowed policy, send drift summary to #eng-security, auto-create JIRA if new drift > 5 principals.
Priya: A3) Audit enrichment (owner: Priya, due: 2026-03-28, ticket INF-4884). We need to ensure every token validation path logs: user_id, token_id, validation_result, and the service-version label. Also add a log marker so downstream SIEM can pick up high-risk failures.
Mira: A4) Secrets rotation reliability (owner: Mira, due: 2026-03-29, ticket INF-4885). Root cause: job exit 137 on one node; need retry/backoff + retry alerts and a health endpoint for rotation workers. Add a canary rotation run daily.
OpsBot: Created tickets: INF-4882, INF-4883, INF-4884, INF-4885. Linking to incident INC-2026-0319-01. :robot_face:
Alex: Quick note — for the alerting burn rate, prefer paged-on-call if >3 hosts failing for 15m. Otherwise post to #ops-alerts.
Sam: For ownership handoff: I'll pair with Mira next Monday for the permission detector runbook and schedule an initial dry run. Proposed runbook steps in INF-4883. :calendar:
Priya: I'll add a test to the CI that asserts audit fields are present for the common validation paths. Will post the PR by EOD Friday.
Mira: Recurrence/trend item — this is the third authz-flavor incident in ~6 months with similar token/rotation symptoms. We should add a recurring review every sprint retro to track regressions and ensure the detectors are getting tuned. Suggest cadence: bi-weekly 30m slot in security retro until false-positive rate < 5%.
Alex: Agreed. Also adding a quick smoke command to the runbook for on-call: ```bash
kubectl -n auth exec deploy/auth-worker -- curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:8080/health/token-check | jq .status
```
Mira: I'll own the coordination: I'll update the incident remediation board with these owners/tickets and ping product/security for any customer-facing notes. Will check back here after the first dry run. :eyes:
Priya: Thanks — ping me if you want help with the SIEM mapping.
Sam: I'll drop the first-week scan results into INF-4883 and @Mira when done.
Alex: Moving to actioning. Marking this thread as the single source for remediation updates. :white_check_mark:
Mira: Closing loop for now. If anyone hits blockers, post here or DM.
